title: Agreement-gated fusion of a vision foundation model and a multimodal LLM for wheat disease diagnosis: code, frozen prompt and cached outputs
description: Code, frozen prompt, study protocol and cached model outputs needed to recompute all results of the manuscript 'Agreement-gated fusion of a vision foundation model and a multimodal large language model for reliable wheat disease diagnosis across image sources' (under review). Images are not redistributed.
